datasets.name: Cryo electron tomography of whole mitochondria and released crista membranes isolated from Caenorhabditis elegans
datasets.size_source: depositor-declared imageset size, EMPIAR API field dataset_size
datasets.subjects: Caenorhabditis elegans isolated mitochondria; imageset 'Tilt series of whole mitochondria isolated from C. elegans used for segmentation': 2 tilt series x 61 tilts, 4096x4096 px, 32 BIT FLOAT, 5.4 A/px; imageset 'Tilt series of crista membranes released from mitochondria isolated from C. elegans': 54 tilt series x 61 tilts, 3838x3710 px, UNSIGNED 16 BIT INTEGER, 3.576 A/px
datasets.constrains_basis: Judgement. The tilt series are the only public raw 3-D cristae geometry in this set; membrane trace lengths, CJ positions and IMS lumen width are measurable from the MRC volumes. Not measured here: no MRC tilt frame was downloaded, so no membrane length in micrometres is asserted.
datasets.access_note: Metadata verified via API HTTP 200. Bulk raw data NOT reachable from this host: ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/EMPIAR/... returned HTTP 404; the PDBj mirror ftp.pdbj.org failed TLS hostname verification. Recorded as a failure (E4), not hidden.
datasets.notes: Deposited 2023-01-27, released 2024-02-08, scale 'cell', related EMDB entry ['EMD-18991'], dataset DOI 10.6019/EMPIAR-11542. One tilt frame of the released-cristae imageset would be 3838*3710*2 = 28477960 bytes (28.5 MB) and is therefore the natural <=50 MB sample, but the file path is not reachable from this host.

datasets.name: Sub-tomogram average of the Caenorhabditis elegans mitochondrial ATP synthase dimer
datasets.subjects: Caenorhabditis elegans ATP synthase dimers subtomogram-averaged from cryo-ET; n dimers NOT stated in the header (UNKNOWN)
datasets.constrains_basis: Judgement. A dimer map fixes the centre-to-centre pitch of ATP-synthase rows, which is the geometric quantity behind a per-area site density, and gives a real 3-D reference for IMS lumen cross-section. The header states no oligomer count, so no absolute site number is derived here.
datasets.access_note: Header HTTP 200; map HEAD HTTP 200 with Content-Length 2688407 bytes; map GET HTTP 200.
datasets.notes: EMDB XML: resolution 38.6 A by FSC 0.143 CUT-OFF; applied symmetry C2; data type float32; dimensions 140x140x140; pixel spacing 3.58 A; annotation  map of the C.

datasets.name: MetaboLights MTBLS4307 - LC-MS metabolite profiling of subcellular fractions (mitochondria vs cytoplasm), TFAM knockdown liver-cancer model
datasets.size_source: MetaboLights public FTP directory listing (human-readable size column)
datasets.format: ISA-Tab s_/a_/m_ text tables; MAF (metabolite assignment file) TSV; vendor .raw LC-MS
datasets.subjects: Homo sapiens SNU-368 hepatocellular carcinoma cells; strain factors: Cell fraction, Genotype, Replicate; 38 sample rows in the LC-HILIC assay table
datasets.constrains_basis: Judgement. The 'Cell fraction' factor is the measured quantity that separates mitochondrial from cytoplasmic adenylate pools, which is exactly the pool split the model fixes by hand. Not measured here: no ATP or ADP value is read out of the MAF in this run.
datasets.access_note: FTP listing HTTP 200; study API HTTP 200; MAF HEAD HTTP 200 (11175 bytes); MAF GET HTTP 200.
datasets.notes: This is a relative-intensity LC-MS assay, not an absolute-concentration assay: the MAF gives peak areas, so it can constrain the RATIO of mitochondrial to cytoplasmic adenylate, not the molar numbers the model uses. Assay platform: Liquid Chromatography MS - alternating - hilic / mass spectrometry. Study title as deposited: TFAM loss induces nuclear actin assembly upon mDia2 malonylation to promote liver cancer metastasis.

datasets.name: Wolf2001_Respiratory_Oscillations - mathematical model of mitochondrial respiratory oscillations (FEBS Lett, PMID 11423122)
datasets.subjects: No new subjects: published quantitative model, not a cohort. Publication: Mathematical analysis of a mechanism for autonomous metabolic oscillations in continuous culture of Saccharomyces cerevi
datasets.constrains_basis: Judgement. A published ODE model of mitochondrial respiratory oscillations is a parameterised statement about turnover numbers and time scales under a stated temperature; it is a model, not a measurement, so it is a prior and an internal-consistency check, never a data point.
datasets.access_note: Model API HTTP None; SBML download HTTP 200, None bytes.
datasets.notes: Not a measured dataset under criterion C3 as written; retained because it is the only public openly-licensed machine-readable carrier of turnover numbers in these reactions, and is labelled as a model.

datasets.name: NO PUBLIC CURATED DATASET FOUND - ADP (or ATP) diffusion coefficient in the mitochondrial intermembrane space
datasets.access_url: not applicable - no candidate reached the verified tier
datasets.constrains_basis: This row records a searched-for and NOT FOUND dataset. The model default is 1.0e-11 m2/s and inputs/Q077_PREREG.md lists it as a scale assumption. Nothing in this run narrows it, and no substitute value (e.g. bulk-solution NMR self-diffusion of ATP, or a molecular-dynamics run) is presented as if it measured the IMS.
datasets.access_note: Nearest proxies identified and deliberately NOT counted: bulk aqueous self-diffusion of adenine nucleotides (different compartment, different viscosity), molecular-dynamics trajectories in MD archives (not a curated diffusion measurement), and cryo-EM structures (no dynamics).
datasets.notes: This gap is the single largest unconstrained input in the model: every transport time in results is linear in 1/diffusion_coefficient.

datasets.name: NO PUBLIC IMS ADP/ATP TIME SERIES FOUND - compartment-resolved adenine nucleotide trajectories inside mitochondria
datasets.access_url: not applicable - no candidate reached the verified tier
datasets.constrains_basis: The model reports three transport times and inputs/Q077_QUESTION.md lists 'transporttider' as a required observable. No public dataset of IMS ADP/ATP concentration versus time was located. Whole-cell or whole-animal adenylate time courses exist but do not resolve the IMS.
datasets.access_note: Closest verified proxy: BioModels BIOMD0000000090, a model of respiratory oscillations - a simulation, not a measurement, and therefore not counted as a time-series constraint.
datasets.notes: The three transport times remain pure model output with no empirical time anchor in this run.
